sourceCheck.summary: WAI-ARIA 1.2 6.7 aria-selected/aria-checked and 5.4 row read. Row supports aria-selected and not aria-checked; false means selectable but unselected, true means selected, undefined means not selectable. Explicit selection takes precedence over implicit focus selection. Grid containment and gridcell ownership are present; treegrid-only row properties are irrelevant. Compared r009-standards-p01 in full: listbox container multiselect capability, whose options already have aria-selected, differs from repairing unsupported checked state on a grid row. Existing selection behavior is supplied, so the new goal is role-supported row selection semantics. Original scenario/code and short independent explanations do not reproduce an official test item or a substantial standard passage.

ambiguityCheck.summary: The sole lowercase ASCII replacement name is aria-selected. aria-current describes current location/item rather than selectable row state, and aria-pressed is not supported on row. Keeping false/true values and the fixed grid/row structure removes alternative redesign answers.
